preconditions.description: The number of missiles N must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= 100000 for t_i in times)
preconditions.description: Each missile's arrival time t_i must be between 0 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= f_i <= 100000 for f_i in frequencies)
preconditions.description: Each missile's frequency f_i must be between 0 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(times[i] <= times[i+1] for i in range(N-1))
preconditions.description: The arrival times of the missiles must be in non-decreasing order.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of hackerX missiles required to defend against all missiles.
